related.title: NSTX-U 球形電漿研究
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對磁形、診斷與核心邊緣整合；NSTX-U 球形電漿研究改以球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on magnetic shaping, diagnostics and core-edge integration; NSTX-U spherical-plasma research centers on spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照可重組場形約束與低aspect ratio約束，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到NSTX-U 球形電漿研究，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以研究方案與可用率為起點，設計一項能區分「磁形、診斷與核心邊緣整合」與「球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare configurable magnetic shaping with low-aspect-ratio confinement and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to NSTX-U spherical-plasma research, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from research regimes/availability and propose an observation distinguishing magnetic shaping, diagnostics and core-edge integration from spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics, including uncertainty.

related.title: ITER 國際磁約束研究工程
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對磁形、診斷與核心邊緣整合；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程改以大型 tokamak 系統、低溫磁體與熱排出為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on magnetic shaping, diagnostics and core-edge integration; ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering centers on large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照可重組場形約束與tokamak真空與磁場，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到ITER 國際磁約束研究工程，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以研究方案與可用率為起點，設計一項能區分「磁形、診斷與核心邊緣整合」與「大型 tokamak 系統、低溫磁體與熱排出」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare configurable magnetic shaping with tokamak vacuum/magnetic fields and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from research regimes/availability and propose an observation distinguishing magnetic shaping, diagnostics and core-edge integration from large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust, including uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: DIII-D 可重組 tokamak 研究
history.text: DIII-D 可重組 tokamak 研究的公開資料展示磁形、診斷與核心邊緣整合的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for DIII-D configurable tokamak research illustrate magnetic shaping, diagnostics and core-edge integration. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將磁形、診斷與核心邊緣整合改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns magnetic shaping, diagnostics and core-edge integration into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
